taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Document share-link authority, recipient scope and revocation lifecycle
controls.source_trace: Trace who can issue or alter a share capability and whether it remains bound to the intended document, audience and operations after changes.
controls.implementation_branch: Determine whether the link intentionally grants bearer access, requires a named recipient or is restricted to a tenant. Possession of an active bearer link is expected authorization under that model. Check permission changes, expiry and revocation at preview/export/download consumers; a cached page shell alone does not show continued private document access.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two owned synthetic documents/users; compare intended share access with an unauthorized issuer, changed object or revoked link.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Anonymous bearer access can be the declared sharing feature; possession alone is not an authorization bypass.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind issuance and share scope/lifetime to policy, retesting valid recipients, permission downgrade and revocation.
